📥 Download Official Sample Templates (All Subjects)

📋 Official KIPS 3-Sheet Excel Workbook Architecture
Every sample file includes the three official sheets required by the KIPS syllabus standard:
• [Term 1]: Lecture-by-lecture planner (Lec #, Unit, Topic, SLO, Vocab, Classwork, Homework).
• [Term II]: Lecture-by-lecture planner for Second / Final Term.
• [Termwise Syllabus]: Section A (Yearly Overview), Section B (Fortnights 1 to 12), and Section C (Round Tests 1-4 & Term Papers).
